Row N56. Lab editor as a full-window app (Spline-style), approved by Koushik on Nov 2. Model Opus 5.5 high, 60 min.

Goal: /lab?editor=1 (room labs and template trials) becomes a full-window 3D lab tool that looks like a real product, not a page of cards. Keep every current feature working (add/move/rotate/resize/delete objects, undo/redo, Play/Reset, room collisions and Show raw scan, Mark the A4 sheet, Add a real object, Build lab shell, templates, agent panel with suggestions and model mode, import/export, graph, fullscreen).

Layout:
- Full window: the site header and footer are hidden on the editor route; a slim top bar has the logo (back to workspace), the lab name (rename inline), undo/redo, Play/Reset, share/export, and the Agent toggle on the right.
- Left panel, collapsible to an icon rail: tabs Objects (scene outline list with type icons, select, hide, delete) and Room (room info, A4 scale marking, Add a real object, Build lab shell, Show raw scan, room collisions).
- Centre: the 3D canvas fills the remaining space. A floating toolbar at the top centre of the canvas: select, move, rotate, resize, plus an Add button that opens a picture menu (icon tiles: ball, block, ramp, pendulum, spring, and any existing kit objects); Template trials folded into this Add menu as a "Templates" section, not a separate orange button.
- Right panel: Properties for the selected object (size, mass, position, fixed, record trajectory sensor) as compact labelled fields; when nothing is selected, show scene settings (gravity, time step if exposed).
- Agent panel: right side drawer toggled from the top bar, referencing Base44 mainly: chat thread, suggestion chips, prompt box with model mode chip, voice button if it already exists. When open it replaces/sits beside Properties, not on top of the canvas.
- Bottom timeline strip under the canvas: play/pause, scrubber with time, a live graph of the tracked quantity (reuse the existing graph data), and a result card (value with uncertainty and its label MEASURED / MODEL-ESTIMATED / SIMULATED) when a run produces one.
- Honesty: replace the row of orange badges with one compact chip (for example "SIMULATED · scale unverified") that expands on click to the full list of labels and caveats. Keep all label words and the "MODEL-GENERATED shape" / "Powered by Stability AI" attribution once (not per object).
- Visuals: better lighting (hemisphere + directional with soft shadow on the floor), matte materials, subtle grid, neutral background in light and dark themes; respect the site's colour modes.
- Scrolling: the page must not trap scroll; panels scroll independently; the canvas only captures wheel for zoom.
- 375 px: panels become bottom sheets / drawers; canvas stays usable.

Workspace preview snapshot: when a lab is saved or a run finishes, capture the canvas (toDataURL, small JPEG/WebP about 640 px wide) and store it for the project so the N55 workspace cards show it. N55 already reads an optional snapshot_url per project (Build/web/src/workspace/projects.mjs). Add the minimal owner-scoped API in Build/api/storage/ to PUT the snapshot (size-limited, image types only) and return snapshot_url in the projects list; tests in tests/api-storage/.

Rules: no em dashes in visible text; numbers only from code/fitter/API; do not touch private room data (the N06 room and DEV room bd7162322f3c4c978383bf797aac2f6e are private; never commit their frames, meshes, JSON or screenshots). Screenshots only of the public RM02 classroom sample or template trials. Playwright Chromium (headed). No paid calls needed; ledger any you make. No deploy.

Owns: Build/web/src/lab-editor/; Build/web/src/app/(public)/lab/; Build/web/src/lab/; Build/api/storage/; tests/lab-editor/; tests/api-storage/; evidence/N56/. If a shared shell file must change (for example hiding the site header on the editor route), keep it to the smallest edit and list it in REPORT.

Accept: looks like a real 3D lab tool at 1366, 1920 and 375 in light and dark (screenshots in evidence/N56/, a few small JPGs only); all editor, room and agent features still work; node --test tests/lab-editor tests/lab tests/api-storage and pytest tests/api-storage pass; npm run build passes.
